purpose: Measure whether GraphRAG returns the right engineering resources for a task. DIAL measures whether the system rejects bad instructions (harness-evals.json) but has never measured retrieval itself. Under supervision a human notices bad context; under autonomy nothing does.
ground_truth_rule: Expectations are derived from DECLARED SEMANTICS - the feature's own registry record (module, outcome, client_exposure, app_families, code_paths) matched against each resource's own declared task_classes - never from observed behaviour. A case that fails is a finding about the system, not a broken expectation.

scoring.recall: fraction of must_include returned in eligible_resource_ids
scoring.note: Exhaustive relevance labels do not exist, so precision is measured against explicit must_exclude rather than over the whole corpus.
scoring.must_differ_from: Two cases naming each other must not return the same resource set. This is the only way to assert that the concrete task - not the Feature record - shapes retrieval.

floors.policy: Ratchet raised on 2026-09-12 to the measured value. Baseline 0.7292 recall / 0.875 precision; after structural task-class signals, typed-field classification and word-boundary keyword matching 0.875 / 1.0; after ENGINEERING_CONCERN nodes let the concrete task enter the graph, registry-owned prose rules for the 25 declared task classes no rule could emit, inflection-tolerant term matching and the terminal resource layer: 1.0 / 1.0 over 10 cases. A floor at the measured value means a new case that fails is a finding to fix, not a reason to lower the floor. Lowering it requires an owner decision.
known_gaps: Fixed since baseline: prose-keyword classification over records carrying only structural facts; whole-record JSON stringification (a grocery feature classified HEALTH_SENSITIVE from an evidence note reading "accepts the gate claim"); substring keyword matching (ref.maplibre.docs keyword "layer" matched "preview-player"); the mirror-image false negative where keyword "schedule" failed against "a scheduled ... monitor"; 25 of 62 declared task classes having no rule that could emit them; contract surfaces entering the prose classifier and firing WHATSAPP on 46.9% of Features; bare `health` and `claim` classifying non-clinical Features as HEALTH_SENSITIVE.

Precision is measured against explicit must_exclude, not over the whole 102-resource corpus. A resource that is irrelevant but unlisted is not counted against the score. Adding cases is how that improves; the floor is not evidence of exhaustive relevance labelling.

cases.instruction: Implement the vehicle selection and garage screens in the customer web app
cases.rationale: client_exposure CUSTOMER, app_families DIAL_WEB, code_paths are .tsx under a Next-style app router. Web UI resources declare WEB_UI_IMPLEMENTATION.

cases.instruction: Harden the garage screen against unsafe deep links and verify the routing security
cases.rationale: Same UI feature under a security concern. Next.js docs declare WEB_SECURITY; the advisory feed declares SECURITY.

cases.instruction: Add failing-first unit tests for catalogue coverage and diagram identity
cases.rationale: DOMAIN_TESTED feature whose test_paths are vitest suites. ref.vitest.docs declares UNIT_TESTING and TYPESCRIPT_TESTING.

cases.instruction: Implement the grocery round purchase plan and credit model in TypeScript
cases.rationale: Pure domain TypeScript package with no UI, no maps and no messaging surface.

cases.instruction: Implement the quote approval flow including the WhatsApp approval message
cases.rationale: app_families includes WHATSAPP and the contract exposes RequestApprovalQuote / ApproveQuote. ref.meta.whatsapp.docs declares WHATSAPP and MESSAGING.

cases.instruction: For TECH-F008 design a human approval flow with authenticated decision, nonce expiry, denial path and audit.
cases.rationale: The documented n8n Pilot 2 instruction verbatim, so the eval measures the canonical expectation rather than a paraphrase of it. The declared route is the anti-pattern resources' own keyword 'human approval' plus task class SECURITY, which this instruction carries. An earlier paraphrase ('review the approval workflow for reliability anti-patterns') carried neither and could never have been satisfied from declared facts - a bad expectation, not a system defect.

cases.instruction: Implement claims adjudication and funder clearance for the health division
cases.rationale: Health-sensitive unit. PROJECT_TRUTH excludes sensitive health data from ordinary community corpora; the corpus must fail closed here. Asserted by the passing specialist-health case in the n8n corpus suite.

cases.instruction: Implement the round ledger postings and reconcile them against the credit model
cases.rationale: Money-path domain code. Should not reach UI, map or browser-automation resources.

cases.instruction: Implement Supabase Postgres RLS policies for Grocery Rounds.
cases.rationale: The concrete task, not the Feature record, decides what is retrievable. GROC-F021's record says 'Round agreement & consent gateway' and mentions no database, so the compile-time projection alone could never reach Supabase. Paired with RE-010 on the same Feature.

cases.instruction: Implement and verify the Next.js customer surface for the same bounded Feature.
cases.rationale: Same Feature and same Unit as RE-009, different concrete task. Asserted by tests/orchestration-vekl-resources.test.mjs 'persists federated resources through audited packet re-resolution when the concrete task changes'. If both cases return the same set the graph neighbourhood is a function of the record alone, which is the defect this pair exists to catch.
